description: T349 chrome stability fixtures. Rows expected to fail are pre-fix reproducers; the owning task flips its row to pass when the fix lands. `scales` runs a row at each listed device scale; the default is 1x.

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640, default status row, Wi-Fi model; open Wi-Fi from its status item
cases.symptom: popup and committed target must land at the status item's clamped anchor at 1x/1.5x/2x

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640, default status row, audio model; open Volume from its status item
cases.symptom: popup and committed target must land at the status item's clamped anchor at 1x/1.5x/2x

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640, default status row, battery model; open Battery from its status item
cases.symptom: popup and committed target must land at the status item's clamped anchor at 1x/1.5x/2x

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640, Bluetooth status item available, Bluetooth model; open Bluetooth from its status item
cases.symptom: popup and committed target must land at the status item's clamped anchor at 1x/1.5x/2x

cases.setup: MenuBar width 360, output 360x640, all four status items available; open Battery near the right edge
cases.symptom: the popup right edge clamps to the output width at 1x/1.5x/2x

cases.setup: MenuBar width 200, output 200x640, all four status items available; open Battery
cases.symptom: an output narrower than the popup clamps it to the left edge and caps its width

cases.setup: MenuBar width 360.5, output 361x640; open Battery
cases.symptom: a fractional bar edge still yields an output-local origin and a right edge inside the output

cases.setup: MenuBar placed at x=1280 on a 1280x720 secondary output; open Wi-Fi
cases.symptom: the popup and committed target stay output-local instead of inheriting the scene origin

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640; open Wi-Fi by pointer then by keyboard activation
cases.symptom: both opening paths share the same anchor x/y

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640; open Wi-Fi then show the clock date
cases.symptom: the open popup follows the relaid-out status row

cases.setup: MenuBar width 360/output 360, then width 800/output 800 while Battery is open
cases.symptom: the popup and committed target re-clamp to the new output bounds

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640, clock status item; click the clock
cases.symptom: the clock panel stays on its status item through the shared output bounds at 1x/1.5x/2x

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with a two-window entry; open the real Dock window chooser
cases.symptom: the committed paint crop includes the rotated arrow tip and the full shadow reach at 1x/1.5x/2x

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with a two-window entry; open the real Dock window chooser
cases.symptom: the material descriptor stops at the card body; the empty bands beside the arrow stay transparent

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with a two-window entry; open the real Dock window chooser
cases.symptom: the picking region is the card body; the shadow, empty arrow band and rounded corners stay click-through

cases.setup: Bottom, left and right Docks with a two-window entry; open the real Dock window chooser
cases.symptom: every anchor publishes card coverage, full arrow/shadow paint extents, and a card-body picking region

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with a running entry; open the Dock context menu
cases.symptom: the context menu crop includes the shadow while picking stays on the card

cases.setup: Bottom Dock over a 16 px checkerboard; open the real Dock window chooser
cases.symptom: the card, arrow and shadow paint while the empty arrow band and rounded corners show the underlay (pixel case stays at 1x; geometry covers 1.5x/2x)

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 800x160 over a plain stage, compositorPopupMotion on; open the real chooser, then mark the closing frame
cases.symptom: the closing commit keeps the settled accepted texture at full QML opacity/scale, covers the full arrow/shadow reach, and releases input

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160, compositorPopupMotion on, Theme.reducedMotion on
cases.symptom: the compositor path uses the zero-duration exit token and still commits the settled texture

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160, compositorPopupMotion on; open, enter the closing frame, then reopen
cases.symptom: a reopen during the compositor-owned tail restores input and a valid paint extent on the same accepted surface

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with compositorPopupMotion off (the local A/B diagnostic)
cases.symptom: the QML opacity/scale path remains available and still fades to zero

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160; open and close the real Dock window chooser
cases.symptom: the persistent plate geometry and its painted pixels below the popup shadow match the baseline

cases.setup: Popup with materialPreset menuAttached over a 16 px checkerboard; QML shadow hidden
cases.symptom: attached menus must keep square top corners and rounded bottom corners

cases.setup: Popup with materialPreset menuDetached over a 16 px checkerboard; QML shadow hidden
cases.symptom: detached menus must leave all four rounded corners transparent

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, Wi-Fi model; open, close, then reopen the Wi-Fi popover
cases.symptom: the cold and warm opens must keep the same anchor and target width, and a closed popover must commit no target

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with Files (2 windows) and Notes (3 windows); open, close, switch, reopen
cases.symptom: the chooser must follow the live entry and retire input at logical close

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800 with one File app menu; open, close, reopen
cases.symptom: the attached menu card must stay current across a close/reopen

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640, File menu with one submenu; open the menu and its submenu
cases.symptom: the committed crop includes each card's shadow reach while material and picking stay on the separate card bodies and the gap is click-through

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, File menu; replace the open model with a wider row, close, then reopen
cases.symptom: the changed model width settles into the crop, material card and picking rects on the next rendered frame and survives the warm reopen

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800 with File/Edit menus and Wi-Fi/Volume status popovers; switch titles, switch status popups, close, and repeat under reduced motion
cases.symptom: one popup owner follows the live title/status card, a logical close publishes no material or picking region, and reduced motion uses a zero-duration exit

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, output 800x640, File menu with a nested submenu, compositorPopupMotion on; open the chain and dismiss it by click-away
cases.symptom: the parent and both submenu cards keep their own masks, placement, material regions and one visual lifetime; the retained chain is inert and the inter-card gap stays click-through

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800 with File/Edit menus and two Edit submenus, compositorPopupMotion on; switch titles and swap the open submenu branch
cases.symptom: a deliberate title or branch swap retires the old chain immediately and never leaves duplicate glass

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, nested File menu, compositorPopupMotion on; dismiss the chain then replace the model
cases.symptom: a delayed provider reply cannot re-label, resize or truncate the retained exit snapshot

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, nested File menu, compositorPopupMotion on; dismiss then reopen during the closing tail
cases.symptom: the reopen clears the exit latch, rebuilds the live chain and restores the picking footprint on the same accepted surface

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, nested File menu, compositorPopupMotion on, Theme.reducedMotion on
cases.symptom: the zero-duration token releases the retained chain immediately with no stale cards

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, nested File menu, compositorPopupMotion on; dismiss by focus loss, click-away and the immediate owner path
cases.symptom: every dismissal route shares one exit; non-immediate routes retain the chain and the immediate route retires it
